definitions.explanation: A financial account held at a bank for depositing and withdrawing money.

examples.japanese: {口座|こうざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
{口座|こうざ}⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えてください→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me your account number.

examples.japanese: {口座|こうざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I deposited money into my account.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{口座|こうざ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{落|お}とされる→引き落とす：23710_hikiotosu⟧。
examples.english: The rent is deducted from my bank account every month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧、⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{口座|こうざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: When I first came to Japan, it took time to open a bank account.

notes:
{口座|こうざ} is essential banking vocabulary. Composed of ⟦{口|こう}→口：noentry⟧ (mouth/opening) + ⟦{座|ざ}→座：noentry⟧ (seat/position).

ACCOUNT TYPES:
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧{口座|こうざ}: savings account (most common)
- ⟦{当座|とうざ}→当座：29548_touza⟧{口座|こうざ}: checking account (for businesses)
- ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧⟦{預金|よきん}→預金：05420_yokin⟧{口座|こうざ}: fixed deposit account

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {口座|こうざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧/⟦{開設|かいせつ}する→開設：14595_kaisetsu⟧: to open an account
- {口座|こうざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じる→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧: to close an account
- {口座|こうざ}⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: account number
- {口座|こうざ}⟦{振替|ふりかえ}→振替：15942_furikae⟧: automatic bank transfer
- {口座|こうざ}⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧: account balance

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with ⟦{講座|こうざ}→講座：09790_kouza⟧ (course, lecture series).
